Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThis section was strongly fortified when it was still in use.\nYou'll find an entrance to Hangar 16 about 500 metres north of your position.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n该区域在仍在使用时被严密设防。\n你将发现通往16号机库的入口，位于你当前位置以北约500米处。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThat door is sealed shut, find a way around it.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n那扇门被封死了，找条路绕过去。

Title: NETMESSAGE:OBJECTIVE UPDATE\n\nFind a way to open the reinforced hatch using the laser barrier and explosives.
Translation: 任务更新\n\n找到一种利用激光屏障和炸药打开加固舱门的方法。

Title: NETMESSAGE:WARNING\n\nMore laser barriers detected.
Translation: 警告\n\n检测到更多激光屏障。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nYou'll have to find a way to open that hatch by force. Maybe use the explosives.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n你必须强行打开那个舱门。也许可以用炸药。
